name: io.github.mhbxyz/kdenlive-mcp
title: Kdenlive
description: Inspect, edit and render Kdenlive video projects locally on Linux.

environmentVariables.name: KDENLIVE_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Colon-separated absolute directories; every file the server reads or writes must be inside them. Unset: only the user's videos directory. 'unrestricted': no limit (not recommended).

environmentVariables.name: KDENLIVE_MCP_KDENLIVE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the kdenlive executable if it is not on PATH (for example an AppImage).

environmentVariables.name: KDENLIVE_MCP_MELT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the MLT melt executable if it is not on PATH.

environmentVariables.name: KDENLIVE_MCP_FFPROBE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the ffprobe executable if it is not on PATH.
